# Prompt Inventory

Every LLM prompt sent by the canvas app and the photo/video studio app. The template modules in
`src/prompt-templates` are the source of truth (also browsable in `prompt-library.html`); these docs are
generated from them, and the test fails when a template, its model, or its docs drift.

## Canvas

| Template | Model | Input → Output | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`canvas-enhance-image-prompt`](templates/canvas-enhance-image-prompt.md) | `gemini-4-hydrogen` | text → text | Rewrite a card's image prompt (or a user-supplied prompt) into a higher quality image-generation prompt before re-rendering the card's image. |
| [`canvas-blend-images`](templates/canvas-blend-images.md) | `gemini-nano-banana-2.1` | mixed → image | Blend two or more canvas cards into a single generated image: the instruction is sent first, followed by each card's image and body text as separate parts. |
| [`canvas-design-concepts`](templates/canvas-design-concepts.md) | `gemini-4-hydrogen` | mixed → json | Generate multiple design concepts (title, description, image prompt) from the selected cards' images and text plus design requirements; used by both Design/Create and Design/Iterate. |
| [`canvas-fill-card`](templates/canvas-fill-card.md) | `gemini-4-hydrogen` | mixed → json | Fill missing canvas card fields (title, body, image prompt) from the card's available text plus its attached image or video, if any. The response schema is built per request from only the missing fields; outputSchema shows the case where all three are missing. |
| [`canvas-generate-personas`](templates/canvas-generate-personas.md) | `gemini-4-hydrogen` | text → json | Generate synthetic user personas (name, age, gender, occupation, description, Gemini Live voice) that vary along a chosen trait within an optional segment. |
| [`canvas-rank-designs`](templates/canvas-rank-designs.md) | `gemini-4-hydrogen` | mixed → json | Rank the selected design cards (text plus attached images) from a persona's perspective against a target trait and return ordered IDs with brief feedback. |
| [`canvas-scan-concepts`](templates/canvas-scan-concepts.md) | `gemini-4-hydrogen` | mixed → json | Distill 3-5 key concepts from the selected canvas items (text and images) through a chosen scan lens. |
| [`canvas-visualize-concept`](templates/canvas-visualize-concept.md) | `gemini-4-hydrogen` | text → json | Generate up to 3 image-generation prompts that visualize the selected cards' text in an abstract or concrete style; each prompt is then rendered with the image model. |
| [`canvas-animate`](templates/canvas-animate.md) | `gemini-omni-1.2-flash` | mixed → video | Generate a short video from the selected canvas cards (Animate tool / animate action). Cards are sent in selection order: video cards as a video part, image cards as image parts (numbered Image1, Image2...), text-only cards as text parts. Annotated starting-frame sketches are appended as extra image parts. The final text part is the instruction: a generated image-role sentence group followed by the user's direction. Aspect ratio, duration, and task (text_to_video, image_to_video, reference_to_video, edit, extend) are request settings, not prompt text. |
| [`canvas-auto-iterate-agent`](templates/canvas-auto-iterate-agent.md) | `gemini-4-neon` | mixed → text | System instruction and first user turn of the Auto-Iterate agent loop, which runs the active workflow (AGENTS.md) on the canvas through Gemini function calling. Tool declarations are not prompt text: they are generated from the agent-visible actions in the action registry (src/lib/actions/defs/*.ts), and each turn restricts tool_choice to the actions currently available. Later turns send function results: the action result JSON, any result media, and a fresh observation (plus thumbnails of newly created cards) after the last call. |
| [`canvas-edit-image`](templates/canvas-edit-image.md) | `gemini-nano-banana-2.1` | mixed → image | Edit a card's image with the image model (Sketch tool / edit_image action). The image is sent first: the Sketch tool's flattened drawing, or for agent calls the source image with labeled regions drawn on it (or the plain source image). The instruction follows as a single text part. |
| [`canvas-interview-live`](templates/canvas-interview-live.md) | `gemini-3.8-live` | mixed → audio | Gemini Live session that role-plays a synthetic-user persona card in a spoken user-research interview. The persona prompt is the session system instruction (voice is the persona's prebuilt Gemini Live voice); the selected design cards are sent once as an initial client-content turn, after which the interviewer's microphone audio streams in and the persona answers in audio. Input and output transcriptions become the transcript that is later summarized. |
| [`canvas-interview-text`](templates/canvas-interview-text.md) | `gemini-4-hydrogen` | mixed → text | Text equivalent of the live voice interview, used by the interview_persona action when questions are given. Uses the same persona system prompt plus a text-mode instruction. Each question is a separate interaction chained via previous_interaction_id; the selected cards' context parts are sent only with the first question. The questions and answers form the transcript that is then summarized into a card. |
| [`canvas-rate-lenses`](templates/canvas-rate-lenses.md) | `gemini-decision-1` | mixed → json | Gemini Decisions API (ai.decisions.create) call, not a chat prompt: one `choice` question whose options are the Scan lenses, evaluated against the selected cards. The lenses compete for probability mass, and the returned per-lens probabilities drive the Scan tool's meter bars (lengths are relative to the top lens). Rendered here as the question instructions, one `key: description` line per option, then the card text input parts. |
| [`canvas-refine-card-text`](templates/canvas-refine-card-text.md) | `gemini-4-hydrogen` | mixed → json | After the Sketch tool (edit_image action) produces an edited image, compare the original and edited images and write a new title and body for the result card. The instruction is sent first, then a caption text part followed by the original image, then a caption text part followed by the edited image. The response is requested as application/json without a schema. |
| [`canvas-search-reference-image`](templates/canvas-search-reference-image.md) | `gemini-nano-banana-2.1` | text → image | Second step of Search (search_references action): for each streamed search result, ask the image model (with Google web + image search grounding, 1:1, 1K) to find and render a representative reference image for the result card. |
| [`canvas-search-references`](templates/canvas-search-references.md) | `gemini-4-hydrogen` | mixed → json | Search the web (google_search tool) for distinct real-world references on a topic and stream them back as JSON results; each result becomes a card. Images of the selected cards are sent as image parts before the text. Afterwards, the search_references action renders one reference image per result with the image model, using the prompt `Search for and generate a clear, representative visual reference image of "<title>". <details>\nSearch topic: <prompt>. Clean single-subject presentation, no text labels or watermarks.` |
| [`canvas-summarize-interview`](templates/canvas-summarize-interview.md) | `gemini-4-hydrogen` | text → json | Turn a persona interview transcript (from the live voice interview or the text interview) into a summary card with a short title and actionable design findings. |
| [`canvas-summarize-workflow`](templates/canvas-summarize-workflow.md) | `gemini-4-hydrogen` | mixed → text | Distill a recorded (and user-edited) action trace into a reusable AGENTS.md workflow that the Auto-Iterate agent can follow. Output thumbnails of the included steps (up to 12) are sent as image parts after the text; the reply is Markdown with any surrounding code fence stripped. |

## Studio

| Template | Model | Input → Output | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`studio-import-canvas-instructions`](templates/studio-import-canvas-instructions.md) | `gemini-4-hydrogen` | text → text | Convert imported canvas concept cards (title and body) into the Studio custom instructions, which are later sent to Gemini as "Additional instructions" in the scene XML synthesis prompt. |
| [`studio-scan-product-features`](templates/studio-scan-product-features.md) | `gemini-4-hydrogen` | image → json | Extract product shapes, materials, mechanisms, and colors from a scanned photo (sent as an image part before the text) using only library-backed options; streamed JSON constrained by a library-enum schema. |
| [`studio-synthesize-scene-xml`](templates/studio-synthesize-scene-xml.md) | `gemini-4-hydrogen` | mixed → xml | Generate a complete product visualization scene XML from selected attributes, optional photos, and custom instructions. |
| [`studio-revise-scene-xml`](templates/studio-revise-scene-xml.md) | `gemini-4-hydrogen` | mixed → xml | Revise the synthesized scene XML in a multi-turn conversation: the prior synthesis turn (selections, reference photos, and model XML output) is sent as history, followed by this revision message. |
| [`studio-generate-sound-description`](templates/studio-generate-sound-description.md) | `gemini-4-hydrogen` | text → text | Generate a natural-language sound description for a staged product photo, run automatically after Take Photo using the staged scene XML and the photo scene as the animation prompt. |
| [`studio-stage-photo-scene`](templates/studio-stage-photo-scene.md) | `gemini-4-hydrogen` | text → xml | Re-stage the current synthesized product XML into a specific photo scene (Take Photo); the result feeds image generation and the sound description step. |
| [`studio-animate-photo`](templates/studio-animate-photo.md) | `gemini-omni-1.2-flash` | mixed → video | Animate a staged studio photo into a short video. The photo is sent as the starting-frame image part, followed by one text part combining the animation instructions and sound description. Requested at 9:16 with the default 4s duration. |
